blocks.text: Abbotsford East homes listed and sold, June to September 2026

Abbotsford East, September 2026. Detached houses: 165 listed at month end and 15 sold in September, a sales ratio of 9% (a buyers’ market). Condos and townhomes: 69 listed at month end and 4 sold in September, a sales ratio of 6% (a buyers’ market).

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal.

blocks.text: Looking across the period, Detached houses: 107 sold over 4 months against an average of 163.5 listed, about 6.1 months of listings at that pace; the busiest month was June with 38 sold. Condos and townhomes: 44 sold over 4 months against an average of 67.2 listed, about 6.1 months of listings at that pace; the busiest month was June with 14 sold.

items.t: No rapid-transit station is in Abbotsford; the area is served by BC Transit buses.
Nearest bus exchange: Montrose Exchange, the endpoint of Route 9.
Route 2 Highstreet / McMillan (BC Transit): Highstreet Exchange via Bourquin Exchange and Montrose Exchange to Abbotsford Rec Centre.
Route 9 McKee (BC Transit): Montrose Exchange via McMillan Rd and Old Yale Rd to McKee and Old Clayburn Rd.
Route 66 Fraser Valley Express (BC Transit): Lougheed Station to Chilliwack via Highstreet Exchange and McCallum Park & Ride, the regional connection.

faq.q: How did Abbotsford East sell in September 2026?
faq.a: Detached recorded 165 active listings, 15 solds and a 9% sales ratio — the highest detached inventory in Abbotsford, with the ratio joint with Abbotsford West (also 9%) — and Condos & Townhomes recorded 69 listings, 4 solds and a 6% ratio, the lowest published attached ratio in Abbotsford; medians are published at community level only (Abbotsford detached $949,000; attached $497,500) (as of September 2026, Source: SnapStats FVR/GVR September 2026 report).

faq.q: How do residents get to Highway 1?
faq.a: Highway 1 runs along the south side of the area with access at Whatcom Road, and the 66 Fraser Valley Express uses Highway 1 between Abbotsford, Langley and Chilliwack.

faq.q: Can a house in Abbotsford East have a secondary suite or a coach house?
faq.a: Under Zoning Bylaw 2014 No. 2400, a secondary suite must be less than 50% of the size of the principal unit, and garden suites and coach houses may occupy up to 15% of the lot area to a maximum of 100 m²; the SSMUH amendment (Bylaw No. 3560-2024, adopted June 25, 2024) governs the small-scale multi-unit frame for eligible lots (see ~/workspace/area-research-2026-11/rules-gaps-2026-11-01.md, items 5 and 7f, read 2026-11-01).

faq.q: What plan guides growth on the mountainside part of Abbotsford East?
faq.a: The McKee Neighbourhood Plan (Bylaw 3400-2023), Schedule E of the Official Community Plan, guides the McKee mountainside neighbourhood, with an open space network of streamside setbacks, critical habitat, geotechnical areas and slopes over 40%.
